name: Sex☆Communication
original_name: セックス☆コミュニケーション
source:
After a drinking party with his work colleagues, the protagonist sees one of his colleagues, a hot married woman, is drunk to high heaven, so he takes her to a hotel, strips her, and takes some nude photos of her.

Feeling bad about ... not having had sex with her, and seeing as she doesn't remember anything, the protagonist tries to engineer the situation once more...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ291300.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
与同事聚餐喝酒后，主人公发现一位性感的已婚女同事醉得不省人事，便将她带到酒店，脱掉她的衣服，拍下了裸照。

他为自己没能…和她发生性关系而懊悔。既然她什么都不记得，主人公便试图再次制造同样的局面…
